episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: After a long rift in their friendship, Sylvia reunites with her old best friend, the newly divorced Will.

episodes.title: Gandalf the Lizard
episodes.summary: Will accompanies Sylvia to an open house. Sylvia helps Will sneak into his ex-wife's home to get the rest of his stuff and make a clean emotional break.

episodes.title: Partner's Retreat
episodes.summary: While Sylvia's husband attends a conference, she spends the day getting drunk with Will—who informs her about a development with his bar.

episodes.title: Divorce Party
episodes.summary: Sylvia throws a divorce party for Will to cheer him up, but it gets out of hand when his rowdy friends try to take control of the night.

episodes.title: My Wife's Boyfriend
episodes.summary: Unnerved by the closeness of Will's relationship with Sylvia, Charlie invites Will to join him and his coworkers at a baseball game.

episodes.title: The Big Two Six
episodes.summary: Will introduces Sylvia to his much younger girlfriend, Peyton—then gets upset when Sylvia hires her as a babysitter.

episodes.title: Let the River Run
episodes.summary: Sylvia struggles to keep up with the brutal pace at her new law firm. Will learns about Reggie and Andy's new plans.

episodes.title: San Diego
episodes.summary: Will and the guys take Sylvia on a business trip to San Diego. Charlie grows more suspicious about Sylvia and Will's relationship.

episodes.title: Slumber Party
episodes.summary: Frustrated by how much time Sylvia is spending with Will, Charlie crosses a line. Will confronts Reggie and Andy.

episodes.title: When Will Met Sylvia
episodes.summary: Season finale. Tensions flare between Sylvia and Will at a housewarming party.

episodes.title: The Engagement Party
episodes.summary: Sylvia and Will navigate the new boundaries of their friendship now that Will is engaged to Jenna.

episodes.title: The Dinner Party
episodes.summary: In an effort to get closer to Jenna, Sylvia and Charlie invite her and Will over for a couples dinner.

episodes.title: The Bachelor Party
episodes.summary: Sylvia and Will's college friend swings into town for the bachelor party. Sylvia helps Will to come to terms with his relationship.

episodes.title: Fore!
episodes.summary: Will advises Sylvia to go corporate. In San Diego, Will's plans with Jenna take an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Jeopardy
episodes.summary: When Will moves in with Sylvia and Charlie, her new job forces the guys to spend one-on-one time together. Charlie goes on Jeopardy!

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.summary: Sylvia, Will, and Katie take a road trip to the desert. Will faces the reality of working for his ex-fiancée. Sylvia questions Charlie's stability.

episodes.title: The Office Party
episodes.summary: Will helps Sylvia throw a party for Charlie's law firm. Charlie makes an announcement.

episodes.title: Young Darcy Mysteries
episodes.summary: Sylvia gets hired to plan a major Hollywood party. Will finds an unlikely investor for his new bar. Charlie contemplates his professional future.

episodes.title: Boundaries
episodes.summary: To avoid dealing with Charlie, Sylvia invites herself along on Will and Katie's adventure to the LA River.

episodes.title: Brett Coyote's Last Stand
episodes.summary: Season finale. Sylvia and Will's friendship hits a wall. Sylvia has a realization about her marriage. Will hears news about his bar.
